notes: SecondQuest production defaults. English is the production and default output language; other locales are fully supported but only rendered on explicit request (--locale <code>). New episodes are scaffolded from these values.

render.policy: Renders use defaultLocale unless --locale is passed explicitly. Non-default locales are never rendered as part of the normal flow.

es.status: provisional — official Spanish voice not selected yet
es.note: voice accepts a Kokoro voice id or a native embedding blend 'a:w,b:w' (weights sum to 1). See the Spanish voice auditions.
